items.title: Walmart (WMT) Launches 40,000 Acre Regenerative Agriculture Effort With General Mills And ADM
items.summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT), General Mills and ADM are working together on a new regenerative agriculture program. The initiative covers 40,000 Midwest wheat acres with goals tied to soil health, water quality and carbon sequestration. The collaboration is designed as a model for broader industry change across food and retail supply chains. This move puts Walmart's role in the food supply chain in focus, as the company links its retail scale to farm level practices. For investors, it adds...
